text_blocks.snippet: A Russian tourist visa is required for most foreign citizens visiting Russia for tourism purposes. It's generally the easiest and most affordable visa option for short-term trips (up to 30 days). To obtain one, you'll typically need a tourist invitation from a registered Russian travel agency or a hotel.
snippet_highlighted_words: required for most foreign citizens visiting Russia for tourism purposes

list.title: Single or Double Entry:
list.snippet: Valid for one or two entries into Russia, respectively, within a specified period (usually up to 30 days).

list.title: Multiple Entry:
list.snippet: For US citizens, a 3-year multiple-entry visa is available, allowing multiple entries and stays of up to 180 days per visit.
Passport: Your passport must be valid for at least six months beyond your planned stay in Russia and have at least two blank pages.
Tourist Invitation: This is a crucial document, often called a visa support letter, issued by a Russian travel agency or hotel. It confirms your accommodation and itinerary.
Visa Application Form: Complete the application form accurately, usually available on the Russian consulate website or through a visa agency.
Passport-style Photo: Provide a recent passport-sized photo.
Consular Fee: Pay the required fee for processing your visa application.

Other Documents: Depending on your nationality and specific circumstances, you may need to provide additional documents, such as a copy of your birth certificate (if a minor), proof of travel arrangements, or a letter stating the date of renunciation of Russian citizenship (if applicable).
Determine the appropriate visa type: Choose between single, double, or multiple entry, based on your travel plans.
Obtain a tourist invitation: Contact a registered Russian travel agency or your hotel to secure a visa support letter.
Complete the application form: Fill out the application form accurately and completely.
Gather supporting documents: Collect all necessary documents, including your passport, photo, and invitation.
Submit your application: Submit your application and documents to the relevant Russian consulate or visa agency.
Pay the fee: Pay the required consular fee.
Wait for processing: Allow sufficient time for the consulate to process your application.

list.title: Specific requirements:
